title: 공공기관의 갈등 예방과 해결에 관한 규정 시행규칙 / queue:ARTICLE:14:0:00014:part:1/1
title_original: 공공기관의 갈등 예방과 해결에 관한 규정 시행규칙
full_text:
Article 14 (Inspection of Conflict Management Status, etc.) The head of the Office for National Administration Coordination shall, unless there is a special reason, notify the relevant administrative agencies in advance, specifying the following items, when intending to inspect the conflict management status of a central administrative agency in accordance with Article 26(1) of the National Public Service Act. (Amended July 2, 2008, March 23, 2013)

1. Items to be inspected
2. Inspection schedule
3. Personal information of the inspectors
4. Any other items deemed necessary for the inspection
